news.title: Bam Adebayo's triple-double ignites Heat's 123-113 victory over Thunder
news.text: In a game that did not feature Oklahoma City's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander or Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo swiped the spotlight, scoring 24 points en route to a triple-double, as the surging Heat defeated the Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night.

news.title: Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win
news.text: — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.

news.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 40 as Thunder beat Pelicans 126-120 in NBA Cup
news.text: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder rallied in the fourth quarter for a 126-120 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday night to improve to 2-1 in NBA Cup play.

news.text: — Brook Lopez scored 26 points and Darius Garland added 24 as the Los Angeles Clippers finished off a 113-112 victory Friday night in an NBA Cup game, sending the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder to a season-high third straight loss.
